title: Counter (toy — HA-0.2 proof scenario)
prompt:
# PRD — Counter (toy)

## Summary
A single-page counter app: one button increments a number shown on screen, and the count persists across reloads.

## Stack
Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, one isolated Supabase Docker stack. No auth.

## Entities
- **Counter**: value (integer, default 0).

## Features
1. A single page shows the current count and an "Increment" button.
2. Clicking Increment adds 1 to the count and persists the new value.
3. Reloading the page shows the last persisted count, not 0.

## Out of scope
Decrement, reset, multiple counters, auth, history of changes.

## Acceptance sketch
- Clicking Increment 3 times shows 3.
- Reloading the page after incrementing still shows the incremented value.
expectedCapabilities: Clicking Increment updates the displayed count.
The count survives a page reload.
